system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Auspex, Basic Thaumaturgy. This power augments Aura Perception, letting you notice the use of any blood magic in your line of sight — Thaumaturgy, koldunic sorcery, Assamite or Setite blood sorcery, active rituals, and enchanted objects alike — distinguishing it from the different signature of living magic. To puzzle out the specifics of a given effect, you pit a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty eight Traits, Occult for retests) against the source; success reveals the name of the power (and its target, if you already know that power yourself). You may sustain the sight beyond one turn by spending a Mental Trait at the start of each subsequent turn, or a Blood Trait to renew it after it lapses. A botch while activating this power costs a permanent Willpower Trait, as with any Thaumaturgy.

Costs 3 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
system.duration: One turn per Mental Trait spent (renewable)
